title.narrative: Technical Assistance for the IPA III Cross-Border Cooperation Programme Serbia - North Macedonia 2021

description.narrative: Contract related to: Technical Assistance for the IPA III Cross-Border Cooperation Programme Serbia - North Macedonia 2021 - The overall objective of the programme is to promote good neighbourly relations, foster Union integration and contribute to social, economic and territorial development of the programme cross-border area by improving social and cultural inclusion and health and by developing sustainable tourism. The programme addresses two thematic priorities (TPs):-         TP1: Promoting employment, labour mobility and social and cultural inclusion across the border, aiming to promote an inclusive society by developing new or upgrading existing services and programmes in the area of social welfare and health.-         TP5: Encouraging tourism and cultural and natural heritage, aiming to activate natural and cultural potentials of the programme area for sustainable tourism.
